## Does an existing feature nearly do it?

<!-- Have a look before filing:
  - a different panel shape:        consensus profile presets, --preset perspectives / red-team / <vendor>-family
  - your own preprompt on a seat:   consensus persona add, spec+persona
  - a different model or endpoint:  compat:<model>@<url>, ollama:<model>, openrouter:<vendor>/<model>
  - sharing a panel:                consensus init --from-profile, consensus pack create
  - measuring a change:             consensus bench --baseline --trials
  - scripting it:                   --json, the MCP server, or the library
-->
